query:

UNION ALL
SELECT 'labor_tiers', slug, COUNT(*) FROM labor_tiers GROUP BY slug HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'delivery_options', slug, COUNT(*) FROM delivery_options GROUP BY slug HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'edge_options', slug, COUNT(*) FROM edge_options GROUP BY slug HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
